title: 第3章 金手指
slug: 制霸好莱坞全本免费-制霸好莱坞最新章节列表
content_zh:
现在她当然不会嫌金手指太大了，怎么也得开个金钱无限啊，要是这神秘力量够大胆的话，来个跨时空贸易的话陈贞都不会嫌少，这要是有个系统那就更美了，随着一步步靠近目标，更多功能陆续解封……
很可惜，她的金手指和许许多多书中人物相比，简直是寒酸到了极点，基本上也就只有一个功能。
发动它的条件很简单，闭目凝思就可以了，陈贞给它起名为‘演艺空间’，只要在心中动念要进入其中，下一刻她就会发现自己处在一个一片漆黑的空间之中，眼前有许许多多DVD碟片在上下飞舞，她随着心意随手就能选中。
这些碟片并非应有尽有，陈贞并没拥有未来十年二十年的全球片库，大部分碟片来自她看过的电影电视剧，以及舞台剧等等，小部分则来自她久闻大名却一直没有欣赏的，总之整个片库里并不会出现她没看过也毫无印象的片子，还是以她的记忆为主。
陈贞的金手指作用一：尽情重看老片。
伸手乱划了一通，陈贞随手选中了1998年上映的经典大片《泰坦尼克号》，她眼前顿时出现了一张IMAX尺寸的大屏幕，空间直接跳过了片头的制片公司信息，开始从头播放这部经典大制作。
空间的时间流速和外界时空比大约是3比1，也就是说陈贞有4、5个小时的时间可以从容欣赏这部片子，但她没有从头全看，而是直接拉到了露丝和杰克在海水中载浮载沉的一幕，把感人肺腑的告白重看了一遍。
而后念叨了一句，“开始模拟。”
哗啦一声，陈贞顿时落入水中。
沉重的爱德华时代服饰泡水后变得更为累赘，虽然水温不低，但巨大的摄影棚必须要有鼓风机帮助空气流通，一阵风吹来，她依然冻得瑟瑟发抖，趴在木板上连爬起身的力气都没有。
“很冷吧？”年轻的李奥纳多——小李子趴在木板边缘和她搭话，他英俊非凡的容貌距离陈贞只有十几公分：“妈的，我也快冻死了。还好詹姆最终决定让我们在温水里拍摄，不然我们非得得上肺炎不可。”
在他们身边是一大群演员，一个个都在温水中载浮载沉，大大小小七八个摄像机对着这个大水池，水池边的滑轨，底部的水下摄像机还有水池外来回走动的工作人员，生动——或者按陈贞疑心的，百分百地还原了泰坦尼克号的拍摄现场，远处甚至还能看到‘世界之王’詹姆斯卡梅隆和另一名男子神色凝重地在讨论着什么。
这就是金手指作用二：重现拍摄现场。
陈贞在这里取代的当然是凯特温斯莱特的位置，她对李奥纳多匆匆一笑，但并没回答什么，远处就已经传来了一声响亮的，“注意，第293场第6幕，第2次拍摄，Action！”
“我很冷，”她催促自己快速入戏，流着眼泪念着对白，“我很冷，杰克。”
“听我说，露丝。”李奥纳多的演技和电影中如出一辙，“你一定会脱险的……”
一段五分钟的对白戏很快就拍完了，导演没有喊‘Cut’，等陈贞设定的时间一到，她又回到了演艺空间，空间里已经出现了一张沙发和一些基本的家具，她在沙发上坐了下来，重放自己刚才出演的片段。
大屏幕上又出现了经典的一幕，但露丝的脸已经换成了陈贞。
金手指作用三：将拍摄场景制作成片。
这并不是简单的重看原始录像那么简单，而是完成了剪辑、后期特效、配音以及修片的最终成品，和公映版本没有任何差别，换句话说，陈贞看到的就是‘假如珍妮简出演泰坦尼克号’这个版本的影片，如果她愿意，她可以从头到尾演完这部片子，然后欣赏一遍公映版本。

珍妮简是日耳曼美女，而且此时的身材要比有‘肥温’之称的凯特温斯莱特更窈窕（当然这个外号并不公平，出演泰坦尼克号时温丝莱特的身材实际上相当标准，只是‘上镜胖十斤’），出镜效果更美，但陈贞看着自己的演出，眉毛却是聚拢了起来。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢制霸好莱坞请大家
content_en:
Now of course she wouldn't think that the golden finger is too big. She has to open an unlimited money. If this mysterious power is bold enough, Chen Zhen will not be too little if she wants to trade across time and space. It would be even more beautiful if there was a system. As she gets closer to the goal step by step, more functions will be unlocked...
It's a pity that compared to many characters in the book, her golden finger is extremely shabby, and it basically has only one function.
The conditions for activating it are very simple. Just close your eyes and meditate. Chen Zhen named it 'Performance Space'. As long as she wants to enter it, the next moment she will find herself in a dark space. There are many DVD discs flying up and down in front of her eyes. She can choose them according to her heart.
These discs are not all available. Chen Zhen does not have a global film library of the next ten or twenty years. Most of the discs are from movies, TV series, stage plays, etc. that she has watched. A small part are from famous names that she has heard about for a long time but has never appreciated. In short, there will be no films in the entire film library that she has not seen and has no impression of. It is still based on her memory.
The first function of Chen Zhen’s golden finger is to rewatch old movies as much as possible.
After scratching around with her hand, Chen Zhen casually selected the classic blockbuster "Titanic" released in 1998. An IMAX-size large screen suddenly appeared in front of her. The space directly skipped the production company information at the beginning of the title and began to play this classic blockbuster from the beginning.
The time flow rate in space is about 3 to 1 compared to the time and space of the outside world, which means that Chen Zhen has 4 or 5 hours to watch the film calmly. However, she did not watch it all from the beginning. Instead, she directly moved to the scene of Rose and Jack floating in the sea, and re-watched the touching confession.
Then he muttered, "Start the simulation."
With a splash, Chen Zhen fell into the water immediately.
The heavy Edwardian clothes became more cumbersome after being soaked in water. Although the water temperature was not low, the huge studio required a blower to help circulate the air. A gust of wind blew, and she was still shivering with cold. She lay on the wooden board without even the strength to get up.
"Is it cold?" The young Leonardo DiCaprio was lying on the edge of the board talking to her. His handsome face was only ten centimeters away from Chen Zhen: "Damn, I'm freezing to death too. Fortunately, James finally decided to let us shoot in warm water, otherwise we would have contracted pneumonia."
Next to them was a large group of actors, all of whom were floating in the warm water. Seven or eight cameras, large and small, were facing the large pool. The slide rails beside the pool, the underwater cameras at the bottom, and the staff walking back and forth outside the pool, vividly - or according to Chen Zhen's suspicion, 100% restored the filming scene of the Titanic. In the distance, you could even see the 'King of the World' James Cameron and another man discussing something with a solemn expression.
This is the second function of the golden finger: recreating the shooting scene.
Of course, Chen Zhen took Kate Winslet's place here. She gave Leonardo a quick smile, but didn't answer anything. A loud voice came from the distance, "Attention, scene 293, scene 6, second shot, Action!"
"I'm cold," she urged herself into the scene quickly, reciting the dialogue with tears in her eyes, "I'm cold, Jack."
"Listen to me, Ruth." Leonardo's acting skills were exactly the same as in the movie, "You will definitely escape danger..."
A five-minute dialogue scene was filmed quickly. The director did not call "Cut". When the time set by Chen Zhen came, she returned to the performance space. A sofa and some basic furniture appeared in the space. She sat down on the sofa and replayed the clip she had just appeared in.
Another classic scene appeared on the big screen, but Ruth's face had been replaced by Chen Zhen.
Golden Finger Function 3: Make the shooting sceneMade into a film.
This is not as simple as rewatching the original video, but the final product that has been completed with editing, post-production special effects, dubbing, and editing. It is no different from the released version. In other words, what Chen Zhen saw was the version of the film "What if Jane Jane starred in Titanic". If she wanted, she could play the film from beginning to end and then watch the released version.
Jenny Jane is a Germanic beauty, and her figure at this time is slimmer than Kate Winslet, who is known as "fat and warm" (of course, this nickname is unfair, Winslet's figure is actually quite standard when she starred in Titanic, she was just "ten pounds fatter for photogenics"), and her appearance is more beautiful, but Chen Zhen's eyebrows gathered when she watched her performance.
